name: LUKAS' CHUNK OBSERVER
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: lukasschr
description: A lightweight, server-side Fabric mod that logs how long each player spends in every chunk to an SQLite database - the raw data for activity heatmaps.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
